summary: New York City resident, senior software engineer, autodidact with a focus on theoretical computer science, strong dislike for C++, interest in functional programming (especially Clojure and Erlang), experience with GUI development using Electron, active in open-source communities, critical of advertising and social media algorithms, advocates for critical thinking education, personal experience with insomnia and mental health issues, engaged in tutoring for GED preparation, strong opinions on political and social issues, particularly regarding free speech and misinformation, enjoys low-budget films and has a penchant for programming challenges, has a family structure that includes a wife, and expresses a desire to pursue a PhD in mathematics.
